standards.title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2019/945 on unmanned aircraft systems (class marks C0-C6)
standards.applies_because: EU market: the drone must carry a class mark (C0 < 250 g, C1 < 900 g, C2 < 4 kg MTOM) with the class requirements (speed, geo-awareness, remote ID)

standards.title: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2019/947 on the rules and procedures for the operation of unmanned aircraft
standards.applies_because: EU operating rules the class mark unlocks (open category A1/A2/A3) — what the buyer may do with it

standards.title: Small Unmanned Aircraft Systems (FAA)
standards.applies_because: US small UAS operating rules (commercial use, < 55 lb)

standards.title: Registration and Marking Requirements for Small Unmanned Aircraft (FAA)
standards.applies_because: US registration of small unmanned aircraft above the weight threshold

standards.title: Remote Identification of Unmanned Aircraft (FAA)
standards.applies_because: US Remote ID broadcast requirement for registered drones

standards.title: FCC Part 15 — Radio Frequency Devices
standards.applies_because: 2.4 / 5.8 GHz control and video link (FCC 15C) + digital device (15B)

standards.title: Radio Equipment Directive (RED)
standards.applies_because: Radio link sold in the EU (RED)

standards.title: Secondary cells and batteries containing alkaline or other non-acid electrolytes — Safety — Part 2: Lithium systems
UN Manual of Tests and Criteria, section 38.3 (lithium batteries)
standards.applies_because: Lithium battery shipped with the product

risks.risk: All-up weight creeps over the class limit (C0 250 g / C1 900 g) with the battery and gimbal
risks.mitigation: Weight budget per part from day one; weigh every prototype; two battery options per class

risks.risk: Flight-controller / ESC failure → fly-away or crash over people
risks.mitigation: Certified flight-controller module with geofence, return-to-home and low-battery landing; ESC current telemetry

risks.risk: Salt spray and sand at the beach (kitesurf use) corrode motors and gimbal
risks.mitigation: Sealed bearings, conformal-coated PCBA, IP43 target on the body, rinse guidance

risks.risk: Wind: gusts above 10 m/s exceed the hover margin of a light drone
risks.mitigation: Thrust-to-weight ≥ 2, wind-speed warning in the app, EASA C-class wind rating on the label

risks.risk: Video link drops over water at distance
risks.mitigation: Dual-band link with diversity antennas; follow-me distance cap

tests.name: Class-mark conformity (MTOM, max speed, geo-awareness, remote ID)
tests.method: Notified body assessment of the C-class requirements

tests.name: Hover endurance and thrust stand
tests.method: Thrust stand per motor/prop, then hover to 20% battery at sea level

tests.name: Drop / crash test of arms and gimbal
tests.method: Drop from 1.5 m on each arm; hinge and gimbal functional check

tests.name: Salt mist on motors and fasteners
tests.method: 48 h 5% NaCl fog, bearing and contact inspection

checks.name: Thrust-to-weight ratio

value.label: estimate
value.source_or_assumption: 4 × 300 g max static thrust per motor/prop (category default unless in the BOM) / 324 g all-up weight

inputs.label: estimate
inputs.source_or_assumption: Body shells 54 g (estimate) + battery 101 g (18.1 Wh at 180 Wh/kg) + 4 × (motor + prop + arm) + gimbal camera + electronics = 170 g (category part weights, Estimate)

notes: Confirm on a thrust stand with the final motor/prop pair

checks.name: Hover flight time from battery energy and hover power
checks.threshold: ≥ 25 min pass, ≥ 15 min warn (category target, Estimate)
checks.formula: P_hover = n T^1.5 / √(2ρA) / FoM / η_drive; T = m g / n, A = π d²/4 (d = 127 mm), FoM = 0.6, η = 0.75; t = E × usable / P

inputs.label: estimate
inputs.source_or_assumption: Body shells 54 g (estimate) + battery 101 g (18.1 Wh at 180 Wh/kg) + 4 × (motor + prop + arm) + gimbal camera + electronics = 170 g (category part weights, Estimate)

inputs.label: estimate

notes: Hover shaft power 27 W (momentum theory); forward flight and wind add 10-30 %

checks.name: Regulatory class by take-off mass
checks.threshold: EU: C0 < 250 g, C1 < 900 g, C2 < 4 kg (Sourced: Regulation (EU) 2019/945, Annex Parts 1-4 (class C0: MTOM < 250 g; C1: < 900 g; C2: < 4 kg), eur-lex.europa.eu CELEX:32019R0945, checked 2026-09-27). US: FAA registration and Remote ID above 250 g (0.55 lb), Part 107 for commercial use (to be confirmed per use)
checks.formula: Class = lowest EU class whose MTOM limit the all-up weight is below

inputs.label: estimate

checks.name: Interference between moving parts

value.label: measured
value.source_or_assumption: Boolean common of every part pair (OCCT), classified by the assembly joints; total 0.0 mm³

checks.threshold: 0 intersecting pairs > 0.01 mm³ between parts that move relative to each other (different rigid bodies, over their motion study) or across a parting line — CAD interference-check practice

checks.formula: V(A ∩ B) for parts of the same rigid body that are not directly joined

build_strategy.title: Module assembly
build_strategy.explanation: You design the product around bought-in, pre-certified modules (e.g. motor + driver, battery pack, radio module, heater + fan): your work is the architecture, the enclosure, the integration and the software; the factory assembles the modules into your parts. Faster and cheaper than designing every sub-system, and the modules' certifications carry part of the compliance.
customisable: Camera / gimbal choice, follow-me software, app

checks.name: Interference between moving parts

value.label: measured
value.source_or_assumption: Boolean common of every part pair (OCCT), classified by the assembly joints; total 0.0 mm³

checks.threshold: 0 intersecting pairs > 0.01 mm³ between parts that move relative to each other (different rigid bodies, over their motion study) or across a parting line — CAD interference-check practice
checks.formula: V(A ∩ B) per pair of solids at the assembled pose and over each moving joint's motion study

checks.name: Overlaps inside rigid bodies (concept geometry)

value.label: measured
value.source_or_assumption: 35 pairs of rigidly joined parts interpenetrate (19 over 5 % of the smaller part)

checks.threshold: Parts of one rigid body should not interpenetrate: overlap > 5 % of the smaller part = concept geometry to pocket at detail design (warn); smaller overlaps are seats (info)
checks.formula: V(A ∩ B) for parts of the same rigid body that are not directly joined

checks.name: Minimum clearance of moving parts

value.label: measured

checks.name: Fasteners by standard

value.label: estimate
value.source_or_assumption: Joint rules (screws per parting-line perimeter, motor mounts, spring bars); sizes from the part scale

checks.formula: Σ fasteners over the assembly joints

checks.name: Joint closure (build123d Joints)

value.label: measured
value.source_or_assumption: Each child re-placed from its joint frame with build123d RigidJoint / RevoluteJoint / LinearJoint.connect_to; 31 joints

checks.threshold: build123d joints re-place every part at its modelled pose: residual < 0.01 mm
checks.formula: |bbox centre after connect_to − modelled bbox centre|

checks.name: Every part is attached

value.label: measured
value.source_or_assumption: Parts with no contact (≤ 0.05 mm, BRepExtrema) with the part they are joined to

checks.threshold: Every part touches the part it is joined to (contact ≤ 0.05 mm)
checks.formula: d(child, parent) ≤ 0.05 mm for every joint
